name: Coderbyte
summary: Coderbyte runs timed skills tests that candidates take on their own. Its pricing lists a monthly plan at $99 for 20 invites and a pay-as-you-go pack at $799 for 60 invites. The site lists webcam proctoring, plagiarism detection and tab-leaving detection, and says tests and projects are graded automatically.

facts.text: The site describes its tests as timed, recorded and automatically graded tests that candidates take independently.
The site lists webcam proctoring for multiple people, no people, and second screens, along with plagiarism detection and tab-leaving detection as cheating prevention features.
The site says projects can be graded automatically against custom criteria, and lists automated grading and reporting on its Pro and Enterprise plans.
The site shows prices with a dollar sign but does not name a currency.

plans.name: Pro
plans.unit: per year, figure shown without a currency symbol
plans.notes: Listed as 1,999 a year. Not recorded as USD because the page shows no currency symbol for this figure.

plans.name: Monthly
plans.notes: Each additional invite is listed at $20.

plans.name: Pay As You Go
plans.notes: Invites expire after 365 days, according to the page.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Listed as starting at $14,995 a year. Add-ons are listed at $1,499 a year each.

hiddenCosts: The site does not name its currency. The dollar sign is used on most prices, and the Pro figure has no symbol.
Add-ons for SSO and SCIM, branding, premium analytics and proctoring, and personality testing are each listed at $1,499 a year.
